description: Sequential supported-browser QA-only recipe. Requires QA Glass Studio fixture, no research/content/plan yet on isolated task3321. Never customer data. Native forms and domain handlers; not npm tests.

steps.fn: async()=>{if(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('launchpad.business-profile.v1')).name!=='QA Glass Studio')throw Error('QA only');for(let i=0;i<100&&!document.querySelector('.market-evidence button:not(:disabled)');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));const root=document.querySelector('.market-evidence');const before=localStorage.getItem('launchpad.market-evidence-notebook.v1.local-business');if(before)throw Error('Expected empty QA research');root.querySelector('button').click();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);const f=root.querySelector('form');const set=async(label,value)=>{const l=[...f.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith(label));const el=l.querySelector('input,textarea,select');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set.call(el,value);el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);};await set('Market hypothesis','QA manual organic research hypothesis');await set('Unanswered questions','QA verify demand manually');await set('Source title','QA public example source');await set('Source URL','https://example.invalid/research');await set('Your observation','QA manually recorded observation, not fetched');await set('Source date','2026-10-28');await set('Relevance to audience','QA audience relevance');[...f.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.trim()==='Reviewed by creator').querySelector('input').click();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);f.requestSubmit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('launchpad.market-evidence-notebook.v1.local-business'));if(saved?.sources[0].title!=='QA public example source')throw Error(root.textContent);return {researchSaved:true,revision:saved.revision};}

async()=>{if(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('launchpad.business-profile.v1')).name!=='QA Glass Studio')throw Error('QA only');for(let i=0;i<100&&!document.querySelector('.ad-concept-studio button:not(:disabled)');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));const root=document.querySelector('.ad-concept-studio');root.querySelector('button').click();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);const f=root.querySelector('form');for(const [label,value] of [['Concept label','QA organic content'],['Audience','QA founders'],['Creative angle','QA manually reviewed'],['Headline','QA planning headline'],['Body or caption','QA manually authored caption'],['Call to action','Review locally']]){const l=[...f.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith(label));const el=l.querySelector('input,textarea');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set.call(el,value);el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);}f.requestSubmit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('launchpad.ad-concept-drafts.v1.local-business'));if(!saved?.some(c=>c.conceptLabel==='QA organic content'))throw Error(root.textContent);return {contentSaved:true};}

async()=>{if(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('launchpad.business-profile.v1')).name!=='QA Glass Studio')throw Error('QA only');for(let i=0;i<100&&!document.querySelector('.v-growth-planner button:not(:disabled)');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));const root=document.querySelector('.v-growth-planner');[...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Create local')).click();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);const f=root.querySelector('form');const set=async(label,value)=>{const el=[...f.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith(label)).querySelector('input,textarea,select');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Object.getPrototypeOf(el),'value').set.call(el,value);el.dispatchEvent(new Event(el.tagName==='SELECT'?'change':'input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);};await set('Plan title','QA organic campaign plan');await set('Reviewed content',f.querySelectorAll('select')[0].options[1].value);await set('Campaign plan','QA review public source and manually authored content');await set('Local CRM',f.querySelectorAll('select')[1].options[1].value);await set('Task intention','consented-follow-up');await set('Follow-up task','QA review consent before any action');const key='ventra.growth-plan.v1.local-business';const before=localStorage.getItem(key);f.requestSubmit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);if(!root.textContent.includes('not opted in')||localStorage.getItem(key)!==before||!f.isConnected)throw Error('Consent refusal failed');await set('Task intention','review-only');f.requestSubmit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);if(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key))?.title!=='QA organic campaign plan'||root.querySelector('form'))throw Error('Save failed '+root.textContent);return {consentRefused:true,inputPreserved:true,reviewOnlySaved:true};}

async()=>{if(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('launchpad.business-profile.v1')).name!=='QA Glass Studio')throw Error('QA only');let root;for(let i=0;i<100;i++){root=document.querySelector('.v-growth-planner');if(root?.querySelector('article'))break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));}if(!root?.querySelector('article'))throw Error('Planner did not restore');const key='ventra.growth-plan.v1.local-business';const original=localStorage.getItem(key);if(!root.textContent.includes('QA organic campaign plan'))throw Error('Reload failed');const edit=()=>[...root.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Edit local')).click();edit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);let f=root.querySelector('form');let input=f.querySelector('input');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(input,'QA unsaved retained');input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);[...f.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Cancel')).click();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);if(localStorage.getItem(key)!==original)throw Error('Cancel wrote');edit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);f=root.querySelector('form');input=f.querySelector('input');const sourceKey='launchpad.market-evidence-notebook.v1.local-business';const source=localStorage.getItem(sourceKey);localStorage.setItem(sourceKey,source+' ');f.requestSubmit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);if(!root.textContent.includes('sources before reloading')||f.querySelector('input')!==input||localStorage.getItem(key)!==original)throw Error('Source drift failed');localStorage.setItem(sourceKey,source);const native=Storage.prototype.setItem;try{Storage.prototype.setItem=function(k,v){if(k===key)throw Error('QA quota');return native.call(this,k,v);};f.requestSubmit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);if(!root.textContent.includes('QA quota')||localStorage.getItem(key)!==original||f.querySelector('input')!==input)throw Error('Quota preservation failed');}finally{Storage.prototype.setItem=native;}const pk='launchpad.business-profile.v1';const profile=localStorage.getItem(pk);try{localStorage.setItem(pk,profile+' ');f.requestSubmit();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);if(!document.querySelector('[aria-label="Unsaved edit recovery"]')||f.querySelector('input')!==input||localStorage.getItem(key)!==original)throw Error('Profile guard failed');}finally{localStorage.setItem(pk,profile);}[...f.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Cancel')).click();await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);return {reload:true,cancel:true,sourceDrift:true,quota:true,profileMutation:true,sameInput:true};}
